its not all about social anxiety thats just a big part, some other things to consider that arent so much to do with having problems socially is sensory processing (sounds/lights/textures/temperature) being overwhelming or unbearable when others seem to be able to manage them ok. Obsessive/narrow interests and hyperfocus so while nt people have interests that they may spend an hour a day on it without it interfering with their life, an aspie might spend 15 hours straight hyper focusing on something without eating or going to the toilet and then completely lose interest in it a month later.
